data.name: Flow_LocalCamera_Processing
data.value: Camera RAW capture → spatial/general calibration → color calibration (optionally replayed from saved parameters) → image flip → database insert → save or cache-only CVRAW. Downstream POI uses the final image orientation.

data.name: Flow_LocalCamera_Notes
data.value: X flips vertically, Y mirrors horizontally, and XY rotates 180°. Rotations of 90° and 270° are not supported. When no calibration template is selected, RAW is not flipped early; the orientation setting is preserved until downstream local calibration finishes. File saving is enabled by default and completes before the node continues. Disabling file saving keeps the image and later color parameters only in cache. Enable file saving for legacy services that require a disk file.
